name: OniLink Bedrock Proxy
author: TheNINJALLO@users.noreply.github.com
description: OniLink is a Java 21 Bedrock proxy with fail-closed OniForward identity forwarding, an authenticated XUID allowlist, and an operations dashboard. This egg verifies its bootstrap release, checks GitHub's latest stable release on every start, and atomically installs checksum-verified runtime updates.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

install_root=/mnt/server
mkdir -p "${install_root}"
cd "${install_root}"

case "${ONILINK_VERSION}" in
    *[!A-Za-z0-9._-]*|'')
        echo "Invalid ONILINK_VERSION: ${ONILINK_VERSION}" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac

base_url="https://github.com/TheNINJALLO/OniLink/releases/download/${ONILINK_VERSION}"

download() {
    asset=$1
    destination=$2
    echo "Downloading ${asset} from ${ONILINK_VERSION}..."
    curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 15 \
        "${base_url}/${asset}" -o "${destination}"
}

rm -f OniLink.jar.download onilink.properties.example.download start-onilink.sh.download SHA256SUMS.download
download OniLink.jar OniLink.jar.download
download onilink.properties.example onilink.properties.example.download
download start-onilink.sh start-onilink.sh.download
download SHA256SUMS SHA256SUMS.download

jar_sha=$(awk '$2 == "OniLink.jar" { print $1 }' SHA256SUMS.download)
config_sha=$(awk '$2 == "onilink.properties.example" { print $1 }' SHA256SUMS.download)
startup_sha=$(awk '$2 == "start-onilink.sh" { print $1 }' SHA256SUMS.download)
if [[ ! "${jar_sha}" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$ ]] || [[ ! "${config_sha}" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$ ]] || [[ ! "${startup_sha}" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$ ]]; then
    echo "Release checksum entries are missing or malformed." >&2
    exit 3
fi
printf '%s  %s\n' "${jar_sha}" OniLink.jar.download | sha256sum -c -
printf '%s  %s\n' "${config_sha}" onilink.properties.example.download | sha256sum -c -
printf '%s  %s\n' "${startup_sha}" start-onilink.sh.download | sha256sum -c -

mv OniLink.jar.download "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
mv onilink.properties.example.download onilink.properties.example
mv start-onilink.sh.download start-onilink.sh
mv SHA256SUMS.download SHA256SUMS
chmod 0755 start-onilink.sh

if [[ ! -f "${CONFIG_FILE}" ]]; then
    cp onilink.properties.example "${CONFIG_FILE}"
    echo "Created ${CONFIG_FILE} from the release template."
else
    echo "Preserved existing ${CONFIG_FILE}. Compare it with onilink.properties.example after upgrades."
fi

mkdir -p cache dashboard logs plugins resource-packs
echo "OniLink bootstrap ${ONILINK_VERSION} installed and verified."
echo "Each container start now checks for the newest published OniLink JAR."
echo "Set the admin-only ONIBRIDGE_FORWARDING_SECRET before starting the proxy."

variables.name: OniLink bootstrap release tag
variables.description: Exact public GitHub release used only during create/reinstall. Normal starts query GitHub's latest stable non-prerelease release and install its checksum-verified runtime files.

variables.name: Server jar file
variables.description: Fixed runtime JAR name used by the verified installer and automatic startup updater.

variables.name: Configuration file
variables.description: Fixed OniLink configuration path. Existing configuration is preserved on reinstall.

variables.name: Enable operations dashboard
variables.description: Serves the authenticated dashboard over TCP on the same numeric primary allocation used by Bedrock UDP. Disable it if dashboard access is provided another way.

variables.name: Enable authenticated XUID allowlist
variables.description: Rejects Xbox-authenticated players whose XUID is not in allowlist.properties. Add your own XUID from the dashboard or console before enabling this setting.

variables.name: Default backend host
variables.description: Private hostname or IP reachable from the OniLink container. Do not use a public player address.

variables.name: Default backend UDP port
variables.description: Private Bedrock UDP allocation of the default BDS or Geyser backend.

variables.name: Server list MOTD
variables.description: First line shown in the Bedrock server list.

variables.name: Advertised player limit
variables.description: Player count advertised by OniLink. This is presentation, not an enforcement limit.

variables.name: Default OniForward secret
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Standard Base64 for at least 32 random bytes. Must equal the default backend validator secret. Never include this value in an exported egg.

variables.name: Survival backend OniForward secret
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Optional secret for configurations using ONIBRIDGE_SURVIVAL_SECRET. It must differ from every other backend secret.

variables.name: Java backend OniForward secret
variables.description: ADMIN ONLY. Optional secret for configurations using ONIBRIDGE_JAVA_SECRET. It must differ from every other backend secret.
